title: 美银Winnie：美联储紧缩预期，香港楼市承压
speaker: Winnie

segments.en: For a few reasons, other than the cross-border liquidity tightening, currently, our house view is forecasting three runs of Fed rate hike.
segments.zh: 除了跨境流动性收紧，我们目前预计美联储将加息三次。

segments.en: Now, even if it's not three runs, but the prospect of potential Fed tightening is going to be negative for the property markets in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 即使不是三次，美联储紧缩的前景也会对香港楼市产生负面影响。

segments.en: Also, historically, Hong Kong's residential property price index tend to be a lagging indicator to HSI. So there's a correlation between stock market and the property market.
segments.zh: 历史上，香港住宅价格指数往往是恒生指数的滞后指标，股市与楼市存在关联。

segments.en: And if, second half of this year, stock market is in more pressure because of the liquidity drain from older papers, IPOs, because of the competition from the Asia IPO and US IPO as well.
segments.zh: 如果下半年股市因老股解禁、IPO竞争面临更大压力，包括亚洲和美国的IPO。

segments.en: And also, there is a quite $1.2 trillion Hong Kong dollar of unlocking from the previous IPO that will come to a lock. That's another liquidity drain and with the cross-border tightening.
segments.zh: 此外，约1.2万亿港元的前期IPO解禁将到期，加上跨境收紧，又是一次流动性抽水。

segments.en: So if Hong Kong market HSI is in more pressure, Hong Kong property will probably see more pressure in the next six months, where more comfortable with the Hong Kong banks.
segments.zh: 因此，如果恒生指数承压，香港楼市未来六个月可能面临更大压力，相比之下更看好香港银行股。
